alert_news.title: Reliance Jio Introduces India's First Giga MIMO Radio, Pioneering Pre‑6G Technology
bullets: India’s first Giga MIMO Radio, a pre‑6G technology developed by Reliance Jio, was unveiled at the India Mobile Congress 2026.
The radio is part of Jio’s proprietary pre‑6G stack and can support both 5G and future 6G networks, promising up to five times the capacity of 5G.
Jio also showcased a common baseband unit designed to facilitate seamless transition between 5G and 6G deployments.

alert_news.title: Adichanallur Inaugurates India's First Site Museum, Preserving Ancient Artifacts
bullets: India’s first site museum was inaugurated at the Adichanallur archaeological site in Thoothukudi district by Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman on 6 Aug 2023.
The museum is part of a world‑class plan to preserve ancient burial urns and artifacts uncovered by the Archaeological Survey of India.
Construction of the permanent museum building remains stalled, with ongoing efforts to protect the site from weather damage.

alert_news.title: Modhera Becomes India's First 24x7 Solar‑Powered Village
bullets: India’s first 24x7 solar‑powered village is Modhera, Gujarat, developed by Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam Limited (GUVNL)
The project includes a 6 MW solar plant and a 15 MWh Battery Energy Storage System, powering electric‑vehicle charging stations

alert_news.title: Adichanallur Hosts India's First Site Museum for Archaeological Artefacts
bullets: India’s first site museum was inaugurated at the Adichanallur archaeological site, Thoothukudi district, by Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman on 6 August 2023
The museum will display ancient burial urns and artefacts uncovered by the Archaeological Survey of India

alert_news.title: Assam's Putul Sonowal Secures India's First Medal at World Bowls Champion of Champions
bullets: India’s first-ever medal at the World Bowls Champion of Champions, achieved by Putul Sonowal from Assam
The medal was won by reaching the semi‑finals in Barham, Australia, marking India’s debut podium finish in the event
